They belong to the [[Korok Gear]] equipment archetype. It is likely they were intended to clear paths through forests. They are mostly commonly found in and around [[Hyrule Field]] and the [[Great Hyrule Forest]]. The [[Shrine Quest]] "[[The Test of Wood]]" requires [[Link]] to use a Forest Dweller's Sword, as well as a [[Forest Dweller's Shield]] and [[Forest Dweller's Bow]], to fight his way to the [[Maag Halan Shrine]]. The trial is failed and must be restarted if Link switches his Weapons or one of them breaks. As a wooden [[Weapon]], Forest Dweller's Swords are flammable and will burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. If dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], they will float. They also will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, nor can they conduct [[Electricity]]. They also are unable to be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_025" |Life = 27 |Power = 22 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 14 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 6 |BuyingPrice = 25 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Forest Dweller's Sword}} {{Stub|TotK}} Forest Dweller's Swords have been decayed as a result of the [[Upheaval]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} ==Trivia== * Forest Dweller's Swords are one of several [[Permanently Missable Items]] in {{BotW}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:AoC Forest Dweller's Sword Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Forest Dweller's Sword ==See Also== {{See Also| * Decayed Weapon * Forest Dweller's Sword✨ * Korok Gear * One-Handed Weapon * Wanderer's Sword * Weapon }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Forest Dweller's Sword}}
